item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hi there! Here's your weather for Tuesday, September 8. It's Tuesday, and the week is getting going. Here in Shanghai, the day will be under a blanket of cloud. It will reach 30 degrees, and drop down to 23 degrees. It will feel hot and sticky out there. Rain is about 39 percent likely today. There are 2 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? It's a hot one. A sun hat and a water bottle are a good idea! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be rather grey and cloudy, reaching 30 degrees. This week is all about the moon. What is your favourite part? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
